name: Rootcleave
description: An elven multi-tool of fitted Silverbark Ash and forged blade work, combining a hand spade, a curved pruning blade, a slim root knife, and a small bark-lifting hook into one balanced grip. Built for working with forest terrain rather than tearing through it — the standard land-working implement carried by foresters, agroforesters, trail wardens, and gatherers across the Feywood.
narrative_effects: Supports forestry, agroforestry, trail work, foraging, light pruning, root cutting, bark lifting, and small camp shaping in one carried tool.
Reduces difficulty of fieldwork that would otherwise require swapping between dedicated tools.
Standard issue for Heartwarden trail crews and elven farmstead practice; recognizable as a working tool, not a weapon.
